description:

Achieving customer satisfaction:

  • Work closely with internal teams to coordinate resources to resolve customer's pre-sales technical blockers and to respond to RFPs.  
  • Coordinate and document customer technical requirements with Product Management for continuing product evolution for EMEA market requirements.

Increasing the sales pipeline:

  • Work closely with Account management to develop sales strategies.

  • Attend tradeshows and events to give presentations and man booths to raise awareness about our product.

  • BS or higher in technical field, MS preferred.

  • Excellent presentation skills, coupled with excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate with customers and internal stakeholders in English.
  • Experience designing a high-level technical solution/architecture based on customer requirements.
  • Experience working in a customer facing role.
  • EU Citizenship required*

  • Experience in communication middleware or protocols, e.g., DDS, MQTT, etc.
  • Strong understanding of messaging and communication patterns.
  • Experience in a specific A&D Domain (e.g. GVA/N-GVA, Avionics, Naval Systems or a similar field).
  • Embedded system experience (Software Development, Debugging etc).
  • Python/Java/.NET development expertise.
  • Knowledge about Hypervisors, Virtualization.

  • Knowledge about current trends in the A&D Industry.

🌟 What We Offer You 

  • Flexible working schedule.
  • Remote working + Home Office Stipend to cover the costs of working from home.
  • 30 days of paid vacation + “Real Vacation Bonus,” an additional bonus for taking more than 1-week of uninterrupted vacation.
  • Annual bonus based on individual and company performance + other prizes and awards. 
  • We recognize employees for their achievements, offer great opportunities for career growth and development, and provide the tools they need to succeed.
  • Pension scheme enrollment.

💙 How is life at RTI

  • We have been certified as a Great Place to Work for six consecutive years both in Spain and the US. In addition, we were listed as one of the Best Companies for Women to Advance.

At RTI, you will work in a positive, supportive, diverse environment with a team that truly cares about you.

Real-Time Innovations (RTI) is the data-streaming company for intelligent distributed systems. RTI Connext® software is the critical nervous system for over 2,000 designs across Aerospace and Defense, MedTech, Automotive, and Robotics. Connext is the only real-time data streaming platform that can both control demanding physical systems and integrate them with cloud applications. title: Forward Deployed Engineer, DACH
description:
About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

 

 

The Role

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Munich — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. You'll embed directly with enterprise customers to architect and ship production systems on Telnyx's global network — voice, messaging, AI, and wireless.

This isn't about demoing products. It's about building real solutions that work at scale.

You'll work side-by-side with a dedicated Enterprise AE — not a demo resource, but a commercial partner who owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, and closes the deal. You own the technical side: discovery, architecture, POC, and production go-live. You win together. No throw-over-the-wall.

The Pod Model

Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account. .

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

What You'll Do

• Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand
• Build and deploy custom implementations: AI Voice Assistants, Telnyx APIs (Voice, Messaging, Fax, Wireless), WebRTC
• Run open-weight LLMs in customer environments — consume GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, and MiniMax through Telnyx Inference (OpenAI-compatible API; there's no model infrastructure for you to run), or deploy self-hosted stacks (Llama, Mistral, and region-specific models like Aleph Alpha's Luminous, or sovereign EU models) behind your own serving engine when air-gapped or sovereign-cloud requirements demand it
• Deploy and operate LiteLLM as the model gateway in customer environments: a unified OpenAI-compatible interface across self-hosted open-weight models and hosted providers, with routing, load balancing, retries and fallbacks, rate limits, and per-team virtual keys
• Instrument and govern LLM usage through the gateway — cost tracking and budgets, caching, logging and observability (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or similar), and guardrails — so customers can see and control what their AI workloads are doing
• Wire production observability for everything you ship — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting (e.g. Prometheus + Grafana for metrics, OpenTelemetry for traces, Graylog or ELK for logs — or the customer's existing stack) — so you and the customer's ops team both know what "healthy" looks like and what pages whom when it isn't
• Design model routing strategies for real-time voice workloads, balancing latency, cost, and quality, with sane fallback behavior when a provider degrades
• Make the build-vs-buy case between self-hosted open-weight models and hosted frontier APIs, and keep the customer's application code portable across both
• Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for German-language use cases and DACH-specific regulatory environments (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data localization)
• Lead POCs, pilots, and production launches from whiteboard to go-live
• Own customer outcomes — stay engaged until the solution is live and stable
• Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap based on field insights from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
• Create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and maintainable solutions for handoff
• Troubleshoot and resolve complex integration issues alongside customer teams

What We're Looking For

• CS degree or equivalent experience
• 3+ years building and shipping production software — you've written code that real users depended on, you've been on-call for it, and you've debugged it when things broke. (A consulting background counts if this is also true of you.)
• Proficiency in multiple languages: Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go — you're more dangerous in some than others. (Telnyx Edge Compute — functions and stateful actors — is TypeScript, so that one pulls double duty.)
• Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
• Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story
• You've wired observability and been paged because of it — Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Graylog, ELK, or equivalent. You know what to monitor, what to alert on, and what "healthy" looks like
• High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count
• You've built APIs from scratch, not just consumed them — OpenAPI spec, REST/GraphQL design, auth, rate limiting, versioning, idempotency
• Event-driven thinking and cloud-native instincts
• Exposure to SIP, WebRTC, or real-time voice/messaging systems
• Self-sufficient by default — there's no engineering team behind you. You read the code and the docs, ask the customer (not your manager), and make sound engineering judgment calls on your own
• Customer-facing engineering experience — you can run discovery with a customer's engineers and present to their executives in the same week
• Ability to translate "it's not working" into root cause
• Comfortable working on customer sites and in high-stakes technical conversations
• Excellent written and verbal communication in English and German. You can run whiteboard sessions, live troubleshooting, and escalations with customer engineering teams.
• Based in Munich, or willing to relocate — this is a hybrid role with travel across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland
• Legally authorized to work in Germany, or eligible for sponsorship

Bonus Points For

• Experience with AI voice assistants, STT/TTS, or LLM-based conversational systems
• Building eval sets for a specific domain
• Hands-on production experience with an LLM gateway — LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway, or an in-house OpenAI-compatible proxy — including config-driven model definitions, routing and fallback rules, and virtual key management
• Familiarity with the open-weight model landscape and the trade-offs between regional and multilingual models, including EU sovereign AI initiatives (Gaia-X, Aleph Alpha, European LLM projects)
• Experience with an inference serving engine behind the gateway — vLLM, SGLang, or TGI for production serving; Ollama for lightweight on-prem — and sizing GPU capacity for self-hosted models (KV-cache footprint, concurrent batch size, and context length against VRAM)
• SQL proficiency (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle)
• ETL and data wrangling experience
• CI/CD pipeline design and automation
• Background in telecom, CPaaS, or high-growth SaaS
• Experience with sovereign or on-prem cloud deployments and DACH regulatory frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, German data sovereignty and localization requirements, Swiss data protection)
• Security mindset (IAM, encryption, audit logging)

• Role Title: Tech Lead
    Department: Engineering

    Role Summary
    As a Tech Lead at CreateFuture, you will use your technical and leadership skills to lead
    and support diverse client projects. Depending on the engagement, this includes
    hands-on coding, software architecture, solution design or delivery leadership and project
    management, ensuring a high standard of delivery in everything we do.
    We focus on high-value, high-impact client outcomes, and we’re not afraid to challenge
    the status quo. You should be curious, pragmatic, and operate well in ambiguous
    environments.
    As a technology consultancy, it’s important for us to not only deliver reliable, scalable
    solutions but to be looking at future trends and other high-impact developments. Your
    curiosity for technology and its application to business opportunities is highly valued
    within the company. We are disrupting consultancy through the use of Artificial
    Intelligence and radical thinking in our approach. We're doing something different, and
    that’s realising significant benefits for our clients. We want you to share that same
    ambition.
    You will also manage a team of technical direct reports, who are themselves working on
    client projects, for whom you will provide actionable feedback, technical guidance and
    mentoring, fostering a continuous improvement, growth and consultancy mindset.
    You will work with clients at every level to understand their problems, set expectations,
    and maximise business value, representing CreateFuture as an engagement lead.
    Role Requirements
    ● Proven, hands-on technical leader delivering complex software.
    ● Demonstrate thought-leadership; supporting our clients and colleagues to
    understand, through modern technology and process, what is possible for their
    business/craft.
    ● Line-manage a team of engineers while maintaining personal delivery
    contributions.
    ● Commercial experience in at least one: Java, .NET, Python, or TypeScript (backend
    or frontend).

    ● Commercial experience with at least one major cloud (Amazon Web Services,
    Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform) and modern infrastructure practices
    (containers, continuous integration/continuous delivery, infrastructure as code).
    ● Strong delivery fundamentals: estimation, planning, and risk/issue/dependency
    management; escalates early with clear options and impacts.
    ● Communicate designs and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical
    stakeholders.
    ● Skilled in difficult conversations and actionable feedback; sets clear standards and
    holds people accountable.
    Desirable:
    ● Tailor ways of working (Scrum or Kanban) to context and drive continuous
    improvement.
    ● Experience in change transformation projects that involved significant Artificial
    Intelligence adoption.
    ● Breadth across multiple languages or disciplines (e.g., Rust, test automation,
    DevOps/platform engineering).
    ● Experience across multiple clouds and cloud-native services.
    ● Contribute to recruitment and pre-sales in a consultancy context.
    ● Represent CreateFuture in the external tech community.
    Role Responsibilities
    Technical leadership:
    ● Communicate designs, trade‐offs, and constraints in the context of client goals.
    ● Lead architecture, solution design, and documentation; make pragmatic
    technology choices.
    ● Contribute code where appropriate; set engineering standards; ensure reviews,
    testing, and maintainability.
    ● Troubleshoot complex issues; drive root‐cause fixes and follow‐up actions.
    Delivery leadership:
    ● Own technical outcomes: scope, estimate, plan, and track to agreed goals.
    ● Highlight risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate early with clear options,
    impacts, and recommendations.
    ● Ensure actionable backlogs and realistic plans; communicate timelines and team
    shape needs.
    People leadership (enable, unblock, hold to account):

    ● Guide direct reports to set themselves clear personal goals, and hold them
    accountable for realising them.
    ● Proactively remove impediments across technical, process, and organisational
    boundaries.
    ● Hold colleagues accountable for commitments and standards; address
    performance issues promptly.
    ● Provide targeted guidance and feedback; recognise achievements.
    ● Line‐manage direct reports; run core rituals (team meetings, 1:1s, objectives,
    reviews).
    ● Contribute to hiring.
    Client leadership:
    ● Build trusted relationships at all levels; translate business needs into technical
    plans.
    ● Manage expectations and scope; articulate value and trade‐offs; identify follow‐on
    opportunities.
    ● Represent CreateFuture as the engagement lead.
    Optional/community:
    ● Contribute to delivery practices and standards
    ● Contribute to pre‐sales.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior/Staff Data Scientist - Measurement, Experimentation & Causal Inference
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

As a Senior / Staff Data Scientist, you will help shape how PlayStation measures the impact of products, features and commercial initiatives through world-class experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.

Working at the intersection of data science, machine learning, product and commercial strategy, you will develop innovative measurement methodologies, define best practices, and provide technical leadership that enables teams across PlayStation to make faster, more confident business decisions.

This role goes beyond traditional A/B testing. You will solve complex measurement problems where controlled experiments are difficult or impossible, applying modern causal inference, statistical modelling and machine learning techniques to generate robust business insights. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, analytics and business teams to raise the standard of experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across the organisation.

This is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions impacting millions of PlayStation players while helping establish best-in-class measurement practices across one of the world's leading entertainment companies.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Develop innovative measurement methodologies across experimentation, causal inference and advanced analytics that improve the quality, reliability and scalability of business decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Design robust measurement approaches across randomised experiments, quasi-experimental methods and observational causal inference where controlled experimentation is impractical.
  • Research, evaluate and prototype statistical, machine learning and AI techniques to solve complex real-world measurement challenges.
  • Apply advanced data science and machine learning techniques where appropriate to complement experimentation and support complex business decisions.
  • Define and promote best practices for experiment design, statistical analysis and causal measurement across multiple product and business teams, helping scale experimentation across PlayStation.
  • Partner closely with senior business leaders, product managers, engineers and analysts to identify high-impact measurement opportunities and ensure product and commercial decisions are supported by rigorous evidence.
  • Partner with engineering teams to influence the evolution of PlayStation's experimentation platform and measurement capabilities, ensuring statistical best practices are embedded into future platform development.
  • Provide technical leadership across multiple product and commercial domains, influencing measurement strategy, analytical standards and long-term technical direction through expertise and collaboration.
  • Mentor and develop analysts and data scientists, helping raise technical capability and analytical excellence across the team.
  • Champion a culture of evidence-based decision-making by educating stakeholders, sharing best practices, and communicating advances in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science.
  • Stay current with emerging developments in statistics, machine learning and AI, identifying opportunities to improve measurement capabilities and analytical workflows.
  • Represent the team across PlayStation, building strong partnerships, engaging senior stakeholders, and promoting technical excellence in data science and experimentation.

What We're Looking For:

Required:

  • Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or another quantitative discipline. PhD preferred.
  • Strong industry experience (5+ years) applying experimentation, causal inference, statistical modelling and measurement science to solve complex business problems.
  • Deep expertise in experimental design, A/B testing and modern causal inference methods, including quasi-experimental approaches.
  • Experience applying advanced data science, machine learning and statistical modelling techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python and SQL for large-scale analytical workflows.
  • Experience developing reusable analytical methodologies, frameworks or libraries that improve measurement quality and consistency across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction, promote best practices and drive adoption through collaboration, technical leadership and senior stakeholder engagement.
  • Strong stakeholder management, executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into clear business recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Curiosity, creativity and a pragmatic approach to solving ambiguous, high-impact business problems.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in gaming, digital products, consumer technology, e-commerce or subscription businesses.
  • Familiarity with modern data engineering and analytics tooling such as Databricks, Snowflake, Git and Airflow.
  • Experience with modern business intelligence and data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Domo or Power BI.
  • Experience applying AI tools, including large language models (LLMs), to improve data science workflows and analytical productivity.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through mentoring, publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions or internal communities of practice.

What You'll Influence:

  • Measurement strategy for PlayStation's largest product and commercial initiatives.
  • Experimentation best practices adopted across multiple business functions.
  • Strategic product and commercial decisions through rigorous causal evidence.
  • The evolution of PlayStation's measurement and experimentation capabilities.
  • Technical excellence in experimentation, causal inference and applied data science across the organisation.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Shape how PlayStation measures product and commercial success across a global business.
  • Influence strategic decisions affecting millions of players worldwide.
  • Solve challenging real-world problems using cutting-edge experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques.
  • Collaborate with talented scientists, engineers and product leaders on high-impact initiatives.
  • Drive the adoption of best practices in experimentation and evidence-based decision-making across PlayStation.
  • Continue developing your technical expertise while mentoring and growing others.

Role overview

We are seeking a Senior Localisation Quality Engineer, a highly skilled and innovative individual who brings together design-phase product thinking, software engineering expertise, localisation awareness, and technical problem solving.

The role builds on the core responsibilities of a Senior Localisation QA Engineer, combining strong localization quality expertise with software engineering, automation, and earlier involvement in the product design and development lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked closely with design teams in Figma, has experience reviewing and validating designs before implementation, understands how localisation impacts product and UI design, and can build scalable technical solutions to improve quality across the product lifecycle. You will partner with design, engineering, product, and localisation teams to identify risks early, improve design quality and localisation readiness, and create tools, systems, and solutions that enable faster and smarter delivery.

Rather than focusing only on post-implementation testing, this role emphasises early engagement in the design phase, including reviewing Figma files, prototypes, design systems, user flows, and content structures to ensure they are scalable, testable, and ready for localisation across languages and regions. You will also contribute as a hands-on engineer, building software, automation, integrations, and AI-driven solutions such as agents, assistants, or plugins that improve workflows, validation, and quality decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines strong software development skills, experience working with design systems and Figma-based workflows, practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation, and hands-on interest in engineering solutions to product and quality challenges.



Responsibilities

Design Systems, Figma & Early Product Quality

- Partner with designers, product managers, engineers, and the wider Localisation team to help identify localisation risks early in the design phase.
- Support the Localisation team by reviewing Figma designs and providing technical and design expertise to improve localisation readiness before implementation.
- Help the Localisation team identify and address design risks such as text expansion, truncation, layout issues, bidirectional languages, locale-aware components, and cross-market scalability.
- .Build and improve tools, automation, and processes that enable Localisation QA to identify issues earlier and at scale, including automated design and content validation, screenshot capture, localisation readiness checks, and quality validation across languages and regions.
- Work with the wider Localisation team to define best practices and guidance that help designers and engineers create products that are ready for localisation from the start.
- Collaborate with design teams on design systems, UI patterns, and content structures to improve quality and reduce downstream issues before code is written.
- Help define quality expectations, localisation considerations, and implementation guidance directly from design artefacts and product requirements.

 

Localisation Quality & Testing

- Perform hands-on Localisation QA testing across multiple languages, platforms, products, and regions, including linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation testing.
- Lead and support complex localisation quality initiatives, while contributing directly to day-to-day testing when needed.
- Develop and improve localisation test strategies covering linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation quality.
- Investigate complex localisation and internationalisation issues and work with engineering, design, product, and localisation teams to identify root causes and appropriate solutions.
- Help define localisation quality standards and ensure localisation considerations are integrated throughout the product development lifecycle, from design through implementation and release.

Software Engineering & Technical Solutions

- Design and develop software, internal tools, automation, and reusable services that improve product quality, design validation, and workflow efficiency.
- Build scalable software solutions that support validation of product experiences across design, development, and release stages.
- Contribute to codebases, frameworks, and technical infrastructure that improve quality signals, design consistency, and localisation support.
- Partner with software engineers to improve feature readiness, system testability, and quality-by-design practices.
- Integrate validation and quality workflows into modern development environments and CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

Automation, Tooling & Process Improvement

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve localisation and product quality across design, engineering, and localisation workflows.
- Design and build tools, automation, integrations, or other technical solutions that help teams review designs, validate content, detect issues, and improve workflows.
- Choose the right technical approach for each problem, which may include traditional automation, scripts, plugins, APIs, AI/LLMs, or existing internal tools.
- Develop solutions that help identify localisation and quality issues earlier in the product lifecycle and provide faster feedback to teams.
- Prototype and test new approaches, measure their value, and develop successful solutions so they can be used by the wider Localisation team and potentially other teams.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as a bridge across design, engineering, product, and localisation teams, helping align quality, scalability, and user experience goals.
- Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex issues into actionable recommendations.
- Influence teams toward a shift-left, design-led quality approach.
- Contribute to planning, design reviews, implementation discussions, and release readiness with a focus on preventing issues early.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to members of the Localisation team, sharing engineering, automation, localisation, and quality best practices.
- Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Design Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, design technology, quality engineering, localisation engineering, or related product development roles.
- Strong hands-on experience in software development, with the ability to build tools, systems, integrations, or automation that solve real product challenges.
- Experience working closely with design teams and Figma workflows, including reviewing designs, prototypes, component systems, and user journeys before implementation.
- Experience validating or testing Figma designs for quality, scalability, localisation readiness, and implementation feasibility.
- Practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation principles in digital products.
- Experience with localisation quality or testing across multilingual products, platforms, or regions.
- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java.
- Hands-on experience building or experimenting with AI agents, plugins, copilots, or intelligent workflow tools.
- Experience with APIs, structured data, system integrations, and modern software development practices.
- Familiarity with developer collaboration tools such as GitHub, JIRA, and Confluence.
- Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and cross-functional delivery models.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong product thinking and problem-solving ability.
  • Comfortable operating across design, engineering, product, and localisation domains.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills.



Desired qualifications

  • Experience with Figma design systems, component libraries, and design-to-development workflows.
  • Experience creating or contributing to Figma plugins, design validation tools, or workflow extensions.
  • Experience building AI agents, assistants, or plugins for design, engineering, content, or localisation use cases.
  • Experience influencing product quality earlier in the lifecycle through design review and engineering collaboration.
  • Familiarity with multilingual product development, translation workflows, or international launch readiness.
  • Experience in video games, consumer technology, digital entertainment, or large-scale product environments.
  • Fluency in one or more non-English languages is a plus.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape next-generation quality, localisation, and design-to-development practices.
  • A dynamic and inclusive workplace where technical excellence, collaboration, and global impact thrive.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a forward-looking engineering environment focused on quality, localisation, automation, intelligent systems, and early product excellence.
